model_contract.bounded_result_semantics: No witness means only that the explicitly enumerated finite cases were checked; it never proves the unbounded source statement.
model_contract.candidate_policy: Source-listed or otherwise encoded known examples are excluded from candidate output.
model_contract.counterexample_or_witness: n and both exact modular residues
model_contract.objects: composite n congruent to 3 or 7 modulo 10
model_contract.premise: n divides both 2^n-2 and Fibonacci u_(n+1)
model_contract.scope_limitation: The source is existential or asks for additional solutions. The executor can certify a new witness but bounded absence has no negative force.
model_contract.source_statement: Does there exist a composite number $n \equiv 3$ or $7 \pmod{10}$ which divides both $2^n - 2$ and the Fibonacci number $u_{n+1}$?
